💡 book-to-skill | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To create structured, referenceable knowledge bases from technical books and documents that can be directly utilized by AI agents during work or study.
✨ Key Features: • Converts technical books and documents into agent skills • Supports multiple input formats (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, HTML, RTF, MOBI) • Enables on-demand loading of skills by AI agents • Reduces token usage compared to direct context inclusion
📖 Summary: Book-to-skill is a Python tool that transforms technical books and documents into structured agent skills. It enables AI agents to efficiently reference and utilize the information from these sources, overcoming the limitations of traditional PDF searching or direct context dumping.
